It does not delete tests, modify golden outputs, loosen tolerances, change model semantics, or bypass checkers. The prepared inputs are ready and contain only a warning that should be carried forward for later evidence collection, so the deterministic tool is safe to run.
risks: Prepared-input warning indicates one or more declared sample project references could not be read; downstream probes must confirm or reject those references before relying on them.
Initial extraction may be incomplete if source inputs omit model, shape, numeric, memory, backend, or deployment details; later checkers must validate coverage and provenance.
Cross-layer mismatch risk if Qwen2 GQA head/KV-head constraints are represented incorrectly as ordinary MHA.
Risk of unproven inferred constraints if the graph includes assumptions not traceable to prepared inputs or executable evidence.
